lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
settings-admin: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
settings-personal: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
17,897 B in 40 pieces of 25 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (104 packages, 516 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
